summary: Feed s057_single to IDS is degraded: 100% of packets are untagged and required VLANs 10, 20 are completely missing, breaking VLAN-aware detection. All other visibility checks (duplicates, one-way, truncation, drops, overload, encryption, tunnels, oversize) are healthy.

findings.root_cause: Packet broker or TAP is stripping 802.1Q tags before delivery - all 20 sampled frames arrived untagged instead of tagged 10/20. Most likely broker ingress port set to strip tags or VLAN filtering/mapping misconfigured to remove tags.
findings.impact_on_tool: IDS requires VLANs 10 and 20 for segmentation-aware detection and correlation. With tags stripped, IDS cannot apply VLAN-specific policies, misses lateral movement between VLANs, and loses coverage/context for alerts.

recommended_fix.why: Restore 802.1Q tags end-to-end so IDS receives VLANs 10 and 20 as required for its detection logic; configure broker to preserve/passthrough tags rather than strip.
